title: Register a limited liability partnership (LL IN01)
text:
If you use your home address as the LLP’s registered office address, it will be available to the public.

 See our guidance on what information we make publicly available .

 Application form LL IN01

 It costs £124 to send a paper application to register (incorporate) an LLP.

 Chrome users may not be able to view checkboxes on printed versions of this form. We advise you to use another browser.

 Continuation pages

 The continuation pages are optional. Use them if you need to provide more details.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
